# Welcome {.unnumbered}

::: {.lead}
This is a summary report and walkthrough of my capstone project at **Western Governors University**. This final stage of my capstone project will satisfy points A-K in the rubric.

## Research Question

::: {.lead appearance="simple"}
**"**Among female homicide victims, can weather conditions, agency population, and location predict whether the victim is Black or not Black?"**"**
:::
